title: Turkish Beans Fasulye
description: A nutrient-rich Turkish dish made with dill pickles, featuring a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Heat the tandoor to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cast-iron teppan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the tandoor-cooked chickpeas and red kidney beans.
Add the chopped parsley, dill, dill pickle juice, tomato paste, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Stir well and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the fasulye simmer for 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the fasulye hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Discard any leftover fasulye and clean the iron teppan.
Allow the teppan to cool before storing it in a dry place.
